```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(readr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}

CarsAccidentsData = read.csv("data/CarsAccidentsData.csv")
notification_cols = c("BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION","FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING", "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING")
active_systems_cols = c("CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE", "DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT", "NHTSA_ESC")

```

```{r}

set.seed(123) 

CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(notification_cols), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.x), replace = TRUE), .x)))

CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(active_systems_cols), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.x), replace = TRUE), .x)))

CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>% 
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("AUTO_CRASH_NOTIFICATION", "ARS")))

CarsAccidentsData$notification_count = rowSums(CarsAccidentsData[, notification_cols] == 1)
```

```{r}

CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  filter(
    DR_DRINK == 0,                                
    VSURCONDNAME == "Dry",                        
    !grepl("(?i)Yes", SPEEDRELNAME),              
    !grepl("(?i)Unknown", SPEEDRELNAME),          
    L_STATUSNAME == "Valid",
    DEFORMEDNAME %in% c("Disabling Damage", "Functional Damage", "Minor Damage", "No Damage"),
    TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION %in% c("Angle", "Front-to-Front", "Front-to-Rear","Rear-to-Side","Sideswipe - Same Direction", "Sideswipe - Opposite Direction")
  )
```


```{r}
# Step 1: Define actual vehicle counts and proportions per notification count
group_sizes = c(
  `0` = 2423,
  `1` = 1280,
  `2` = 1486,
  `3` = 1441
)

group_probs = c(
  `0` = 0.3655,
  `1` = 0.1931,
  `2` = 0.2241,
  `3` = 0.2173
)

# Step 2: Summarize accidents by notification_count
accidents_by_notifications = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  group_by(notification_count) %>%
  summarise(num_accidents = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    group_size = group_sizes[as.character(notification_count)],
    group_prob = group_probs[as.character(notification_count)],
    accidents_per_vehicle = num_accidents / group_size,
    accidents_per_percent = num_accidents / group_prob
  )

# Step 3: Plot actual number of accidents (not normalized)
ggplot(accidents_by_notifications, aes(x = factor(notification_count), y = num_accidents)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Accidents by Number of Safety Systems",
    x = "Number of Safety Systems",
    y = "Number of Accidents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```



```{r}
# Step 2: Create 'combo' column (e.g., "101")
CarsAccidentsData$combo_alert_systems = apply(CarsAccidentsData[, notification_cols], 1, paste0, collapse = "")

# Step 3: Count number of accidents per combo
combo_summary = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  group_by(combo_alert_systems) %>%
  summarise(num_accidents = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Define all possible combinations of safety systems
all_combos = expand.grid(
  BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION = c(0, 1),
  FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING = c(0, 1),
  LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING = c(0, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(combo_alert_systems = paste0(BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION, FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING, LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING))

# Step 5: Define actual counts and percentages per combination
empirical_counts_alert_systems = c(
  "000" = 2423,
  "001" = 446,
  "010" = 277,
  "100" = 557,
  "110" = 782,
  "101" = 487,
  "011" = 217,
  "111" = 1441
)

empirical_probs_alert_systems = c(
  "000" = 0.3655,
  "001" = 0.0673,
  "010" = 0.0418,
  "100" = 0.084,
  "110" = 0.1179,
  "101" = 0.0735,
  "011" = 0.0327,
  "111" = 0.2173
)

# Step 6: Merge all data and compute normalized metrics
final = left_join(all_combos, combo_summary, by = "combo_alert_systems") %>%
  #filter(!(combo %in% c("000", "111"))) %>%   # <<< מסיר את 000 ו־111
  mutate(
    num_accidents = replace_na(num_accidents, 0),
    group_size = empirical_counts_alert_systems[combo_alert_systems],
    group_prob = empirical_probs_alert_systems[combo_alert_systems],
    accidents_per_vehicle = num_accidents / group_size,
    accidents_per_percent = num_accidents / group_prob,
    num_active_systems = stringr::str_count(combo_alert_systems, "1")
  )

# Step 7: Plot actual number of accidents (Y = num_accidents)
ggplot(final, aes(x = combo_alert_systems, y = num_accidents)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Accidents by Safety System Combination",
    x = "Safety System Combination (BFL)",
    y = "Number of Accidents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# קריאת הקובץ
car_safey_combinations = read_csv("data/car_safety_combinations_final_correct.csv")

# יצירת עמודת קומבינציה (3 ביטים של התראה + _ + 3 ביטים של אקטיביות)
car_safey_combinations = car_safey_combinations %>%
  mutate(
    combo_all_systems = paste0(
      FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING,
      LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING,
      BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
      CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE,
      DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT,
      NHTSA_ESC
    )
  )

# סידור לפי כמות תאונות מהגבוה לנמוך
car_safey_combinations = car_safey_combinations %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# חלוקה ל־4 קבוצות של 16 קומבינציות כל אחת
car_safey_combinations$group = rep(1:4, each = 16)

# ציור גרף עבור כל קבוצה
for (g in 1:4) {
  chunk = filter(car_safey_combinations, group == g)
  p = ggplot(chunk, aes(x = combo_all_systems, y = Count)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Number of Accidents by Alert + Active Combination (Group", g, ")"),
      x = "System Combination (Alerts_Actives)",
      y = "Number of Accidents"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
 
  print(p)
}

```

```{r}

# שלב 1: סינון תאונות חמורות בלבד
CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  filter(DEFORMEDNAME == "Disabling Damage")

valid_combos = c("001", "010", "100", "110", "101", "011")

CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  filter(combo_alert_systems %in% valid_combos)

# שלב 3: אחוזים וכמויות באוכלוסייה
empirical_probs_alert_systems = empirical_probs_alert_systems[!names(empirical_probs_alert_systems) %in% c("000", "111")]
empirical_counts_alert_systems = empirical_counts_alert_systems[!names(empirical_counts_alert_systems) %in% c("000", "111")]


# שלב 4: נרמול לפי גודל קבוצה
CarsAccidentsData = CarsAccidentsData %>%
  mutate(
    combo_prob_alert_systems  = empirical_probs_alert_systems[combo_alert_systems],
    combo_count_alert_systems = empirical_counts_alert_systems[combo_alert_systems],
    weight_alert_system = 1 / combo_prob_alert_systems
  )

# שלב 5: מודלים עם interactions ו־weights
model_front = glm(grepl("Front", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
                   data = CarsAccidentsData, family = "binomial", weights = weight_alert_system)

model_side = glm(grepl("Side", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING +
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                    LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
                  data = CarsAccidentsData, family = "binomial", weights = weight_alert_system)

model_angle = glm(grepl("Angle", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
                   data = CarsAccidentsData, family = "binomial", weights = weight_alert_system)


```

```{r}
# שלב 6: חילוץ מקדמים
extract_coefs = function(model, crash_type) {
  tidy(model) %>%
    mutate(CrashType = crash_type)
}

coef_table = bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(model_front, "Front"),
  extract_coefs(model_side,  "Side"),
  extract_coefs(model_angle, "Angle")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING" = "Front Warning",
      "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING" = "Lane Warning",
      "BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION" = "Blind Spot",
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING" = "Front + Lane",
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION" = "Front + Blind",
      "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION" = "Lane + Blind"
    ),
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# significant = coef_table %>%
#   filter(p.value < 0.05)
# 
# kable(significant, digits = 3, caption = "Significant Effects (p < 0.05)")

```


```{r}
ggplot(coef_table, aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = CrashType)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Coefficient Plot (Serious Crashes, Normalized)",
    x = "System or Combination",
    y = "Coefficient (Log-Odds)",
    color = "Crash Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
model_front_extend = glm(grepl("Front", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + # 011100
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT + # 011010
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE, # 110100
                   data = CarsAccidentsData, family = "binomial", weights = weight_all_systems)

model_side_extend = glm(grepl("Side", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                    BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:NHTSA_ESC + # 100001
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:NHTSA_ESC,# 011001
                  data = CarsAccidentsData, family = "binomial", weights = weight_all_systems)

model_angle_extend = glm(grepl("Angle", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + # 010100
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT + # 010010
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + # 011100
                     BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:NHTSA_ESC, # 110001
                   data = CarsAccidentsData, family = "binomial", weights = weight_all_systems)
```

```{r}
# פונקציית חילוץ מקדמים ממודל
extract_coefs <- function(model, crash_type) {
  broom::tidy(model) %>%
    mutate(CrashType = crash_type)
}

# איחוד כל המודלים
coef_table <- bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(model_front_extend, "Front"),
  extract_coefs(model_side_extend, "Side"),
  extract_coefs(model_angle_extend, "Angle")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      # Blind + Active
         "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING" = "Front + Lane + Imminent_Brake",
         "BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:NHTSA_ESC" = "Blind + ESC",
         "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:NHTSA_ESC" = "Front + Blind + ESC",
      .default = term  # משאיר את כל היתר ללא שינוי
    ),
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# מסנן רק מקדמים מובהקים
significant <- coef_table %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

# הצגת טבלה
knitr::kable(coef_table, digits = 3, caption = "Significant Effects (p < 0.05)")
```



```{r}


# טבלת תוצאות
effects_df <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("Front + Blind -> +ESC","Blind -> +ESC"),
  From_OR = exp(c(0.402, -0.150)),
  To_OR = exp(c(-0.989, -0.449)),
  CrashType = c("Angle",  "Side")
) %>%
  mutate(
    PercentChange = (From_OR - To_OR) / From_OR * 100
  )

colors = c("Side" = "indianred" ,  "Angle" = "steelblue")

# ציור גרף
ggplot(effects_df, aes(x = Comparison, y = PercentChange, fill = CrashType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(PercentChange, 1), "%")),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(scale = 1),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Reduction in Crash Odds After Adding Safety Systems",
    y = "Reduction",
    x = "System Addition",
    fill = "Crash Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```
